title: Shell
intro: Any command line as a harness: the input is run as a shell script in the session's workspace and its output is the answer. No provider is needed. Fork it to wrap a CLI of your own, agent or not.

verified.how: the API suite, through a worker: a first turn writes a file, a continuation reads it, a streamed turn

notes: provider_env is empty, so the platform issues no token and starts no gateway forwarder: the sandbox has no way out but the run egress list (empty here).
instructions run first as a setup script; a steer runs as one more script after the current one ends.
The workspace persists for the session: continue with previous_response_id and the files are there.
Add egress hosts in harness.json to let the script reach the network; add a CLI in install.sh under $HG_TOOLS.
